decision: Reprimand (Driving) (This is the driver's 1st reprimand of the season)
event_name: Date 05 November 2021 Time 13:20 2021 MEXICAN GRAND PRIX 4 - 7 November 2021 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, summoned (document 10) and heard from the driver and team representative, have considered the following matter and determine
fact: Failed to follow the Race Director's Instruction.
offence: Breach of Article 12.2.2.1.i) of the FIA International Sporting Code.
penalty: Reprimand (Driving) (This is the driver's 1st reprimand of the season)
reason: The Stewards heard from the driver of Car 7 (Kimi Raikkonen) and team representative. Car 7 left the track on the left-hand side between turns 1 and 2 and re-joined the track before turn 2 rather than re-joining by driving to the left-hand side of the bollard at turn 3. Whilst noting the driver's comments in relation to crossing the grass at this point, the Stewards consider this to be a failure to follow the Race Director's instruction given in article 21.1a) of the Race Director's Event Notes.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
title: Offence Car 7 Turn 2
